dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: That Tusheng kid's pretty quick on the uptake...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's things with your Sumpter Beasts?

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Well, very well! Chili and Yun have both put on quite some weight, and they're much stronger now.

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Don't tell him this, but Tusheng's pretty good. His Sumpter Beast feed's quite popular with them both.

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: He's quite the hardworking one, too. Works from early till late preparing the feed, and he doesn't miss a beat.

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: He's different from those other Treasure Hoarders, I'll tell you that!

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: But seriously, why did he join them for, with a pair of hands as diligent as his... I suppose that's bad company for you...

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: In which case, I suppose that makes it my duty to steer him back onto the right path!

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Oh, him? I got him to buy some pastries while I was delivering my goods, so he's gone to a roadside pavilion to wait for me.

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Oh, drat! I forgot all about him! Tusheng, Tusheng, quickly, go get that fellow. He's probably still in the pavilion!

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Stay safe! I've got to go take care of Chili and Yun.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seems like you two are getting along better nowadays...

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: Me? And that Tusheng? Hahaha! You sure are funny. Look, I'm just an old fellow giving him food, board, and a salary out of the goodness of my heart. And he's turned out quite good at toughing his job out.

dialogues.speaker: Wenhua
dialogues.text: In short, it's a boss-employee relationship, alright? Just that.
